name: category.localeIn
title: Field: category.localeIn
description: Meaning of the allowed category locale filter.
meaning: Restricts category results to one of the provided locales.
text:
# category.localeIn

TL;DR:
- category.localeIn limits category labels to one of the allowed locales.

Agent hint:
- Use this when the UI or user context supports more than one locale but you still want a controlled set.
